newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht weaker, interbank rate soft late.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht weaker, interbank rate soft late.

text.p: The Thai baht was weaker against the dollar in offshore and domestic markets in line with the U.S. unit's firmness against the yen overseas, dealers said.

The baht was quoted at 24.100/24.200 to the dollar late in the offshore market compared with 23.950/24.050 late on Wednesday. In the local market, the baht was traded at 25.770/25.790 late against 25.740/25.750 late on Wednesday.
The mid-rate was fixed at 25.71 to the dollar, unchanged from Wednesday.
Dealers said the demand for baht among offshore players remained strong as many positions established when the baht came under attack in mid-May were maturing over the next few days.

A two-tier offshore and onshore baht market has been in place since mid-May after speculative attacks on the currency prompted the BOT to impose what dealers called capital controls to cut off baht supply to offshore speculators.
The baht/dollar one-month swap premium was traded at 110/130 satangs per dollar in offshore and 16/20 in domestic market.
